title: Every app open and every leave re-reads the member's whole workout history for the cloud copy
what: For a member signed in to a MettleUp account, the app reads every workout and every set ever logged, packs and compares them, 3 seconds after each app open and each time the app is left, even when nothing changed. This runs inside the same queue as the app's own saves, so a member who opens the app and starts logging right away waits behind it; with years of history the delay grows with every workout.
expected: The copy only reads what changed since the last copy, so opening the app and starting a workout feels the same on day 1 and in year 3.
who: members signed in to a MettleUp account
how_often: every app open and every time the app is left
fix_line: Drop the forced full read at open and leave when the change stamp is unchanged, and read only workouts edited since the last copy

items.reason: this area is phone code (coach, backup, cloud copy); it holds no panel page
a member's phone holds only that member's data; no list of gym members is loaded here. Server pages are limited to 1000 rows and the phone pages at 500
